claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: no file of vLLM v0.32.0's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names PYTHONNOUSERSITE; the result lists the files the scan read. CPython reads it when the interpreter starts, to leave the user's site-packages directory off sys.path. That it changes which installed packages are importable and no scheduling, KV-cache or pricing decision of the engine is a reading of the interpreter's documented behaviour, not something the harness shows. Recorded InferenceX runs state it as an environment variable of the container.
